tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Who is this issuer? A name, ticker, ISIN, LEI, CIK or Companies House number (optionally a market: US · UK · CA · DE · FR · NL · CH · AU · SG · JP · KR · HK) resolves to the issuer keys on the record, with name, tickers, status and claim standing. Open.

tools.name: get_issuer
tools.description: One issuer row by issuer_key. Open at the facts level (name, tickers, identifiers, status, claim standing, how many rows the record holds for it); the full signed row — every field with its source page and read date — settles on x402 inside the call.

tools.name: list_filings
tools.description: The news rows the record holds for an issuer: filings, releases and third-party coverage, newest first, from a date. Open at the facts level (id, date, type, title, counts); the signed rows with their source pages settle on x402.

tools.name: get_delta
tools.description: What has this issuer filed or released since my last read? Pass the instant (or date) of your last read — for one issuer, or for a whole market with market=US·UK·CA·DE·FR·NL·CH·AU·SG·JP·KR·HK and no issuer; the signed delta — every new row with its source page and the delta envelope signed — settles

tools.name: get_row
tools.description: One news row by id. Facts level open; the full signed row (source page, publisher, read date, signature) settles on x402.

tools.name: claim_row
tools.description: An issuer claims its row, free: the issuer's domain and a contact; the nightly claims rail reads the domain and the row moves listed → claimed (verified when the domain answers on its cadence). A claim that stops answering falls back to listed.

tools.name: create_order_intent
tools.description: An order intent for a paid read (the full row or the delta): returns the x402 terms for mcp.issuerwire.ai and the intent id to carry into the paid call. Nothing is sold but the read.

tools.name: log_audit
tools.description: Write a signed audit line to the ledger (kinds: read · claim · order_intent · note) for a reference id from this door; returns the ledger event id.
